> For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://ultimateshop.superiormc.cn/llms.txt). Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs; this page is available as [Markdown](https://ultimateshop.superiormc.cn/format/itemformat-tm/component-format.md).

# Component Format

Paper components are configured inside the `component` section of an [ItemFormat](/format/itemformat-tm.md). This feature requires **Paper 1.21.5 or later** and **UltimateShop Premium**. Components introduced in newer Minecraft versions require the corresponding server version.

Keep `material` and `amount` at the ItemFormat root. Put Paper component options under `component`:

```yaml
material: DIAMOND_SWORD
amount: 1

component:
name: 'Component sword'
lore:
- 'Built with Paper components'
glow: true
damage: 25
max-damage: 2048
```

Component options are applied after the root ItemFormat options. When both configure the same property, the component value is applied last. `debuild-item-method` controls how items are **saved to ItemFormat**; you do not need to change it to build an item from a `component` section.

Use numbers and booleans as YAML numbers and booleans, without quotes. Use lowercase namespaced registry IDs such as `minecraft:sharpness` and `minecraft:attack_damage`. Enum values such as `EPIC`, `EAT` and `ADD_NUMBER` use the spelling shown in the examples.

## Server version support

| Minimum Paper version | Components and options |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1.21.5 | Base components documented below, including food, tools, equipment, consumables, damage resistance and blocking |
| 1.21.6 | Attribute display modes; `equippable.can-be-sheared` and `equippable.shear-sound` |
| 1.21.11 | Attack range, damage type, kinetic weapons, minimum attack charge, piercing weapons, swing animation and use effects |
| 26.1 | Damage resistance and blocking also accept lists of damage type IDs |
| 26.2 | Sulfur cube content |
| 26.3 | Attack/interact animations, waxed signs, cushion color, villager food, pottery patterns, mob visibility and sign text |

Options for an unregistered component are not a compatibility fallback: they will not be applied on an older server. Use the examples for your server version. For a practical checklist and complete sample items, see [Testing Paper Components](https://github.com/ManyouTeam/UltimateShop/tree/master/docs/format/itemformat-tm/component-testing.md).

The version suffix on each component heading is the minimum Paper version supported by the plugin's component adapter. Options added later have their own version heading.

## Custom Name - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.name`.

Sets the custom display name. MiniMessage formatting is supported.

```yaml
component:
name: Paper component name test
```

## Item Name - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.item-name`.

Sets the item name component independently of the custom display name.

```yaml
component:
item-name: Paper component item name
```

## Lore - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.lore`.

Sets the lore lines in their configured order. MiniMessage formatting is supported.

```yaml
component:
lore:
- First lore line
- Second lore line
```

## Custom Model Data - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.custom-model-data`.

Each type is a separate list. `float` entries must be numbers and `flag` entries must be booleans. Values should remain in the same order and should not multiply when the item is saved and rebuilt.

```yaml
component:
custom-model-data:
float:
- 101.0
- 202.5
flag:
- true
- false
string:
- test-a
- test-b
color:
- '#FF5555'
- '#55FF55'
```

Custom model data does not create a model. A resource pack must define how these values change the item's appearance.

## Max Stack Size - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.max-stack`.

Accepts 1–99. Use a stack size of 1 for damageable items.

```yaml
component:
max-stack: 16
```

## Damage - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.damage`.

Sets the amount of durability already used. Use a non-negative integer; this is not the remaining durability.

```yaml
component:
damage: 37
```

## Max Damage - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.max-damage`.

Sets the maximum durability to a positive integer. Use `max-stack: 1` for a damageable item.

```yaml
component:
max-damage: 2048
```

## Enchantment Glint - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.glow`.

Overrides the enchantment glint. Use `true` to show it or `false` to hide it.

```yaml
component:
glow: true
```

## Unbreakable - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.unbreakable`.

Use `true` to prevent normal durability loss. Omit this option when testing durability loss and item breakage.

```yaml
component:
unbreakable: true
```

## Rarity - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.rarity`.

Accepts `COMMON`, `UNCOMMON`, `RARE` or `EPIC`.

```yaml
component:
rarity: EPIC
```

## Repair Cost - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.repair-cost`.

Sets the prior-work penalty used by an anvil. Use a non-negative integer.

```yaml
component:
repair-cost: 7
```

## Enchantable - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.enchantable`.

Sets the enchantability value. Use a non-negative integer.

```yaml
component:
enchantable: 20
```

## Break Sound - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.break-sound`.

Sets the namespaced sound key played when the item breaks. Test with a damageable item without `unbreakable: true`.

```yaml
component:
break-sound: minecraft:block.glass.break
```

## Enchantments - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.enchants`.

Maps enchantment registry IDs to levels. These are the item’s active enchantments.

```yaml
component:
enchants:
sharpness: 5
unbreaking: 3
```

## Stored Enchantments - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.stored-enchants`.

Maps enchantment registry IDs to stored levels, as used by enchanted books.

```yaml
component:
stored-enchants:
sharpness: 4
mending: 1
```

## Hidden Tooltip Components - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.hide-tooltip`.

Lists native component registry IDs to hide in the tooltip. Hiding the tooltip does not remove the data or disable its behavior.

```yaml
component:
hide-tooltip:
- minecraft:enchantments
- minecraft:attribute_modifiers
```

## Attribute Modifiers - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.attributes`.

Attribute `type` and modifier `name` are namespaced keys. `slot` uses an equipment slot group such as `mainhand`, `offhand`, `hand`, `head`, `chest`, `legs`, `feet`, `armor` or `any`.

```yaml
component:
attributes:
- type: minecraft:attack_damage
name: ultimateshop:test_damage
amount: 8.0
operation: ADD_NUMBER
slot: mainhand
- type: minecraft:attack_speed
name: ultimateshop:test_speed
amount: -1.5
operation: ADD_NUMBER
slot: mainhand
```

Use `ADD_NUMBER`, `ADD_SCALAR` or `MULTIPLY_SCALAR_1` for `operation`.

### Attribute Display - 1.21.6+

Each entry can also use `display-mode: RESET`, `HIDDEN` or `OVERRIDE`. `DEFAULT` is an alias for `RESET`; `TEXT` is an alias for `OVERRIDE`. When no mode is specified, the 1.21.6+ adapter hides the modifier's tooltip display. `OVERRIDE` requires `display-text`:

```yaml
component:
attributes:
- type: minecraft:attack_damage
name: ultimateshop:custom_damage
amount: 8.0
operation: ADD_NUMBER
slot: mainhand
display-mode: OVERRIDE
display-text: 'Custom attack bonus'
```

## Food - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.food`.

Sets nutrition, saturation and whether the item can be eaten at full hunger. Use `consumable` to configure its use animation, duration and consume effects.

```yaml
component:
food:
nutrition: 6
saturation: 0.6
can-always-eat: true
```

## Consumables - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.consumable`.

`food` sets nutrition and saturation. `consumable` controls the use animation, duration, sound and consume effects. Include `can-always-eat: true` when testing food at full hunger.

```yaml
material: APPLE
amount: 1
name: '&bTest consumable'
component:
food:
nutrition: 2
can-always-eat: true
consumable:
consume-seconds: 1.25
animation: EAT
sound: minecraft:entity.generic.eat
effects:
'1':
type: apply-effect
probability: 1.0
effects:
- minecraft:speed,200,0,false,true,false
'2':
type: play-sound
sound: minecraft:entity.player.levelup
```

Consume effects are entries inside `consumable.effects`. Each entry has a `type` and its own settings:

| Type | Settings |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apply-effect` | `probability` from 0.0 to 1.0, plus an `effects` list |
| `play-sound` | `sound`, a namespaced sound key |
| `random-teleport` | `diameter`, the teleport diameter; old `chance` input is also accepted |
| `clear-effect` | No additional settings; removes all status effects |

A potion effect string is `effect ID,duration in ticks,amplifier,ambient,particles,icon`. Amplifiers start at 0. The first three fields are required; omitted boolean fields default to true. Effects are applied in the configured order. For example, put `clear-effect` before `apply-effect` if the new status effects should remain.

```yaml
component:
consumable:
consume-seconds: 1.0
animation: EAT
effects:
'1':
type: clear-effect
'2':
type: apply-effect
probability: 1.0
effects:
- 'minecraft:speed,200,0,false,true,false'
'3':
type: random-teleport
diameter: 4.0
```

Each effect entry adds only its own effect. Saving a consumable uses this same numbered-entry structure.

## Use Cooldown - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.use-cooldown`.

`cooldown-seconds` accepts a non-negative number of seconds, including fractional values such as `1.5`. `cooldown-group` is a namespaced key shared by items in the same cooldown group. Test on a usable item, for example an apple with `food` and `consumable` configured.

```yaml
component:
use-cooldown:
cooldown-seconds: 3
cooldown-group: ultimateshop:component_test
```

## Use Remainder - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.use-reminder`.

The existing configuration key is **`use-reminder`**. Keep that spelling even though the native component is called `use_remainder`. Its value is a complete nested ItemFormat, directly under `use-reminder`, without an extra `item:` wrapper. Material, amount and nested component values are preserved when saved and rebuilt.

```yaml
material: APPLE
amount: 1
name: '&bTest use-reminder'
component:
food:
nutrition: 1
can-always-eat: true
consumable:
consume-seconds: 1.0
animation: EAT
sound: minecraft:entity.generic.eat
use-reminder:
material: GLASS_BOTTLE
amount: 1
component:
name: Bottle returned after use
```

## Tool - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.tool`.

Each rule string is `block ID[,additional block IDs],speed,correct-for-drops`. Use `true`, `false` or `null` for the last field. Use namespaced block IDs.

```yaml
component:
tool:
damage-per-block: 1
mining-speed: 4.0
destroy-blocks-in-creative: true
rules:
- minecraft:stone,minecraft:deepslate,12.0,true
- minecraft:dirt,6.0,false
```

## Equippable - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.equippable`.

```yaml
material: LEATHER_CHESTPLATE
amount: 1
name: '&bTest equippable'
component:
equippable:
slot: CHEST
equip-sound: minecraft:item.armor.equip_leather
asset-id: minecraft:leather
allowed-entities:
- minecraft:player
dispensable: true
swappable: true
damage-on-hurt: true
equip-on-interact: false
```

### Shearing Options - 1.21.6+

These additional equipment options require Paper 1.21.6+:

```yaml
component:
equippable:
slot: CHEST
can-be-sheared: true
shear-sound: minecraft:entity.sheep.shear
```

## Glider - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.glider`.

Adds gliding behavior when `true`. Use an appropriate wearable item with `equippable.slot: CHEST` when testing.

```yaml
component:
glider: true
```

## Dyed Color - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.leather-color`.

Sets the leather dye color. Accepts a quoted hex string such as `'#55AAFF'`, an RGB string such as `'85,170,255'`, or an RGB integer string.

```yaml
component:
leather-color: '#55AAFF'
```

## Armor Trim - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.trim`.

Sets armor trim material and pattern using namespaced registry IDs. Both IDs must exist on the server.

```yaml
component:
trim:
material: minecraft:diamond
pattern: minecraft:sentry
```

## Damage Resistance - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.damage-resistant`.

A string value refers to a damage type tag without a leading `#`, such as `minecraft:is_fire`.

```yaml
component:
damage-resistant: minecraft:is_fire
```

### Damage Type List - 26.1+

A list contains individual damage type IDs instead of a tag string. These are different formats: `minecraft:is_fire` is a tag, while `minecraft:in_fire` is an individual damage type.

```yaml
component:
damage-resistant:
- minecraft:in_fire
- minecraft:on_fire
```

## Blocks Attacks - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.blocks-attacks`.

Configures blocking behavior. `block-delay-seconds` is a numeric delay in seconds; `block-sound` is a separate namespaced sound key. A string `bypassed-by` value refers to a damage type tag without a leading `#`.

```yaml
component:
blocks-attacks:
block-delay-seconds: 0.25
disable-cooldown-scale: 1.0
block-sound: minecraft:item.shield.block
bypassed-by: minecraft:bypasses_shield
```

### Bypassed Damage Type List - 26.1+

Use a list of individual damage type IDs for `bypassed-by` on Paper 26.1+.

```yaml
component:
blocks-attacks:
block-delay-seconds: 0.25
bypassed-by:
- minecraft:arrow
- minecraft:trident
```

## Weapon - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.weapon`.

Configures durability damage per attack and how long the weapon disables blocking.

```yaml
component:
weapon:
damage-per-attack: 2
disable-blocking-seconds: 3.0
```

## Bundle Contents - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.bundle-contents`.

Each named or numbered entry is a complete ItemFormat with `material`, `amount` and an optional `component` section. Saving and rebuilding must retain the nested item types, amounts and component data.

```yaml
material: BUNDLE
amount: 1
name: '&bTest bundle-contents'
component:
bundle-contents:
'1':
material: DIAMOND
amount: 2
component:
name: Diamond inside bundle
'2':
material: EMERALD
amount: 3
```

## Charged Projectiles - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.charged-projectiles`.

Each named or numbered child is a projectile ItemFormat. Do not put a single `material` directly under `charged-projectiles`. A saved and rebuilt crossbow should retain its configured projectile.

```yaml
material: CROSSBOW
amount: 1
name: '&bTest charged-projectiles'
component:
charged-projectiles:
'1':
material: ARROW
amount: 1
```

## Banner Patterns - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.banner-patterns`.

Each list entry uses `pattern registry ID: DYE_COLOR`. Patterns are applied in the configured order.

```yaml
component:
banner-patterns:
- 'minecraft:stripe_bottom: RED'
- 'minecraft:cross: BLUE'
- 'minecraft:border: BLACK'
```

## Potion Contents - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.potion`.

`base-effect` uses a `PotionType` enum value. Custom effects use `effect ID,duration in ticks,amplifier,ambient,particles,icon`; the effect ID is namespaced and amplifiers start at 0.

```yaml
component:
potion:
base-effect: SWIFTNESS
color: '#55FFFF'
name: component_test
effects:
- minecraft:strength,600,1,false,true,true
- minecraft:regeneration,200,0,false,true,false
```

## Potion Duration Scale - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.potion-duration-scale`.

Multiplies the duration of potion effects. Test on an item with potion contents.

```yaml
component:
potion-duration-scale: 2.0
```

## Suspicious Stew Effects - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.suspicious-stew-effects`.

Each entry needs only `effect ID,duration in ticks`. Older entries with additional fields remain readable; those extra fields do not change the stew effect.

```yaml
component:
suspicious-stew-effects:
- minecraft:night_vision,200
- minecraft:saturation,20
```

## Fireworks - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.firework`.

Use `trail`, not `trial`. Flight `duration` is inside `firework`, alongside the numbered effect entries; it accepts 0–255.

```yaml
component:
firework:
duration: 2
'1':
type: STAR
flicker: true
trail: true
colors:
base:
- '#FF5555'
- '#55FF55'
fade:
- '#5555FF'
```

## Axolotl Variant - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.axolotl-variant`.

Sets the axolotl bucket variant using an enum value such as `BLUE` or `LUCY`. Test with `AXOLOTL_BUCKET`.

```yaml
component:
axolotl-variant: BLUE
```

## Tropical Fish Base Color - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.tropical-fish-base-color`.

Sets the tropical fish bucket’s body dye color. Test with `TROPICAL_FISH_BUCKET`.

```yaml
component:
tropical-fish-base-color: ORANGE
```

## Tropical Fish Pattern Color - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.tropical-fish-pattern-color`.

Sets the tropical fish bucket’s pattern dye color. Test with `TROPICAL_FISH_BUCKET`.

```yaml
component:
tropical-fish-pattern-color: BLUE
```

## Tropical Fish Pattern - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.tropical-fish-pattern`.

Sets the tropical fish bucket’s pattern enum, such as `KOB`.

```yaml
component:
tropical-fish-pattern: KOB
```

## Player Profile - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.skull`.

`skull` (or `skull-meta`) is a base64 texture property in this Paper component format, rather than a player-name lookup. Texture display also depends on the client being able to load the texture. Test with `PLAYER_HEAD`.

```yaml
component:
skull: eyJ0ZXh0dXJlcyI6eyJTS0lOIjp7InVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly90ZXh0dXJlcy5taW5lY3JhZnQubmV0L3RleHR1cmUvN2YzZmVkMTZmZDU1MTkwOWZhNWUyOWNkZDY5N2VlMzQ2ZTYzMzkwYjM4M2E0MzAwYTY2MmE4MGI2NGQ5ZWIxNyJ9fX0=
```

## Instrument - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.music`.

Sets a registered instrument using its namespaced ID. Test with `GOAT_HORN`.

```yaml
component:
music: minecraft:ponder_goat_horn
```

## Jukebox Playable - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.song`.

Sets a registered jukebox song using its namespaced ID. Test by inserting the item into a jukebox.

```yaml
component:
song: minecraft:cat
```

## Ominous Bottle Amplifier - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.ominous-bottle-amplifier`.

Accepts 0–4. Test with `OMINOUS_BOTTLE`.

```yaml
component:
ominous-bottle-amplifier: 2
```

## Item Model - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.item-model`.

Sets the namespaced item model key. Custom models require matching resource pack assets; the key alone does not create a model.

```yaml
component:
item-model: minecraft:diamond_sword
```

## Tooltip Style - 1.21.5+

Configuration key: `component.tooltip-style`.

Sets a custom tooltip style key. The spelling is `tooltip-style`, not `tootip-style`. A matching resource pack asset is required to change its appearance.

```yaml
component:
tooltip-style: minecraft:component_test
```

## Attack Range - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.attack-range-key`.

The configuration key is **`attack-range-key`**. Reach values accept 0–64, `hitbox-margin` accepts 0–1, and `mob-factor` accepts 0–2.

```yaml
component:
attack-range-key:
min-reach: 0.0
max-reach: 4.0
min-creative-reach: 0.0
max-creative-reach: 5.0
hitbox-margin: 0.3
mob-factor: 1.0
```

## Damage Type - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.damage-type`.

Sets the weapon’s damage type using an individual damage type registry ID, rather than a damage type tag.

```yaml
component:
damage-type: minecraft:player_attack
```

## Kinetic Weapon - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.kinetic-weapon`.

Configures kinetic weapon contact cooldown, delay, movement, damage multiplier, sounds and conditions. Condition durations are measured in ticks. Test separately from other components that change the same attack interaction.

```yaml
component:
kinetic-weapon:
contact-cooldown-ticks: 10
delay-ticks: 2
forward-movement: 0.3
damage-multiplier: 1.5
sound: minecraft:entity.player.attack.sweep
hit-sound: minecraft:entity.player.attack.knockback
damage-conditions:
max-duration-ticks: 20
min-speed: 0.15
min-relative-speed: 0.1
knockback-conditions:
max-duration-ticks: 30
min-speed: 0.12
min-relative-speed: 0.08
dismount-conditions:
max-duration-ticks: 15
min-speed: 0.2
min-relative-speed: 0.1
```

## Minimum Attack Charge - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.minimum-attack-charge`.

Accepts a value from 0 to 1 for the minimum attack charge.

```yaml
component:
minimum-attack-charge: 0.65
```

## Piercing Weapon - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.piercing-weapon`.

Configures piercing weapon knockback, dismount behavior and sounds.

```yaml
component:
piercing-weapon:
deals-knockback: true
dismounts: true
sound: minecraft:entity.player.attack.sweep
hit-sound: minecraft:entity.player.attack.strong
```

## Swing Animation - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.swing-animation`.

Configures the legacy swing animation. On Paper 1.21.11 through 26.2 this supplies the swing component. On Paper 26.3+ it supplies both attack and interact animations, except where an explicit `attack-animation` or `interact-animation` section overrides its respective side.

```yaml
component:
swing-animation:
type: NONE
duration: 7
```

## Use Effects - 1.21.11+

Configuration key: `component.use-effects`.

Configures sprinting, interaction vibrations and movement speed while using the item. `speed-multiplier` accepts 0–1. Test on a usable item with a use duration, for example an apple with `food` and `consumable` configured.

```yaml
component:
use-effects:
can-sprint: true
interact-vibrations: false
speed-multiplier: 0.4
```

## Sulfur Cube Content - 26.2+

Configuration key: `component.sulfur-cube-content`.

The content is a complete nested ItemFormat.

```yaml
component:
sulfur-cube-content:
material: DIAMOND
amount: 1
```

## Attack Animation - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.attack-animation`.

Sets the attack animation independently. Takes precedence over `swing-animation` for attack behavior.

```yaml
component:
attack-animation:
type: NONE
duration: 9
```

## Interact Animation - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.interact-animation`.

Sets the interaction animation independently. Takes precedence over `swing-animation` for interaction behavior.

```yaml
component:
interact-animation:
type: NONE
duration: 5
```

## Sign Text Front - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.sign-text-front`.

Configures the front side of a sign. Use four lines, a dye color and `glowing` as needed. Test by placing an `OAK_SIGN` item.

```yaml
component:
sign-text-front:
lines:
- Front line 1
- Front line 2
- Front line 3
- Front line 4
color: RED
glowing: true
```

## Sign Text Back - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.sign-text-back`.

Configures the back side of a sign. Use four lines, a dye color and `glowing` as needed. Test by placing an `OAK_SIGN` item.

```yaml
component:
sign-text-back:
lines:
- Back line 1
- Back line 2
- Back line 3
- Back line 4
color: BLUE
glowing: true
```

## Waxed - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.waxed`.

Use `true` to add the waxed state to a sign item. Check whether the placed sign is sealed against editing.

```yaml
component:
waxed: true
```

## Cushion Color - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.cushion-color`.

Sets the cushion dye color using a dye color enum such as `RED`. Use an appropriate material and interaction to check the visible result.

```yaml
component:
cushion-color: RED
```

## Villager Food - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.villager-food`.

Sets the item’s villager food value. Test the relevant villager interaction with an appropriate item material.

```yaml
component:
villager-food: 4
```

## Provides Pottery Pattern - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.provides-pottery-pattern`.

Sets a decorated pot pattern using its namespaced registry ID. The pattern must exist on the server.

```yaml
component:
provides-pottery-pattern: minecraft:angler
```

## Mob Visibility - 26.3+

Configuration key: `component.mob-visibility`.

Applies a visibility factor to the listed entity types. `visibility` accepts 0–10. Entity IDs must exist in the server registry.

```yaml
component:
mob-visibility:
entities:
- minecraft:zombie
- minecraft:skeleton
visibility: 0.5
```

## Saving and testing

Set `debuild-item-method: COMPONENT` in `config.yml` and reload the plugin to save supported item properties inside a `component` section. This setting does not change how Minecraft stores the item itself.

For file installation, give commands, round-trip checks and version-specific examples, continue to [Testing Paper Components](https://github.com/ManyouTeam/UltimateShop/tree/master/docs/format/itemformat-tm/component-testing.md).

➗Math Calculate Format

Unlike most plugins, UltimateShop allows you to fill in the Placeholder API and mathematical calculation format in almost all options applicable to numbers, making it easy to set the price, buy/sell limits, and more you want.

You need enable math.enabled option in your config.yml file to use this feature.

Result precision

math.scale controls the number of decimal places in mathematical results. UltimateShop uses HALF_UP rounding. Applying a multiplier also counts as a mathematical calculation, so multiplier results—including sell price modifiers, previews, and final rewards—use the same scale.

Copy

math:
scale: 2

For example, with scale: 2, multiplying 10 by 0.333333 produces 3.33.

List of match calculate format

max - Compare two number and return bigger value. (max(4,5))

min - Compare two number and return smaller value. (min(4,5))

() - Create a parenthetical expression which will be evaluated first (3 * (4 + 1))

$ - Denotes a variable ($1 / 3)

e - Euler's constant (log(e))

pi - pi (sin(pi))

+ - Add two numbers (1 + 1)

- - Subtract two numbers, or negate one (3-2, -(4+2))

/ - Divide two numbers (3 / 4)

* - Multiply two numbers (2 * 3)

^ - Raise one number to the power of another (3^3)

% - Take the modulus, or division remainder, of one number with another (7 % 4)

abs - Take the absolute value of a number (abs$1, abs-1)

round - Rounds a number to the nearest integer (round1.5, round(2.3))

ceil - Rounds a number up to the nearest integer (ceil1.05)

floor - Rounds a number down to the nearest integer (floor0.95)

rand - Generate a random number between 0 and the specified upper bound (rand4)

log - Get the natural logarithm of a number (log(e))

sqrt - Get the square root of a number (sqrt4)

cbrt - Get the cube root of a number (cbrt(8))

sin - Get the sine of a number (sin$2)

cos - Get the cosine of a number (cos(2*pi))

tan - Get the tangent of a number (tanpi)

asin - Get the arcsine of a number (asin$2)

acos - Get the arccosine of a number (acos0.45)

atan - Get the arctangent of a number (atan1)

sinh - Get the hyperbolic sine of a number (sinh(4))

cosh - Get the hyperbolic cosine of a number (sinh(4))

true - Boolean constant representing 1

false - Boolean constant representing 0

= - Compare if two numbers are equal (1 = 1 will be 1, 1 = 3 will be 0), also accepts ==

!= - Compare if two numbers are not equal (1 != 2 will be 1, 1 != 1 will be 0)

> - Compare if one number is greater than another (1 > 0)

< - Compare if one number is less than another (0 < 1)

>= - Compare if one number is greater than or equal to another (1 >= 1)

<= - Compare if one number is less than or equal to another (0 <= 1)

| - Boolean or (true | false), also accepts ||

& - Boolean and (true & true), also accepts &&

! - Boolean not/inverse (!true)

Functions

The math expression system provides several built-in functions for performing common calculations, including summation, minimum and maximum value selection, averages, and random number generation.

These functions are available when the following option is enabled in config.yml file:

When this option is disabled, custom math functions will not be registered.

# ➗Math Calculate Format

Unlike most plugins, UltimateShop allows you to fill in the Placeholder API and mathematical calculation format in almost all options applicable to numbers, making it easy to set the price, buy/sell limits, and more you want.

{% hint style="info" %}
You need enable `math.enabled` option in your `config.yml` file to use this feature.
{% endhint %}

## Result precision

`math.scale` controls the number of decimal places in mathematical results. UltimateShop uses `HALF_UP` rounding. Applying a multiplier also counts as a mathematical calculation, so multiplier results—including sell price modifiers, previews, and final rewards—use the same scale.

```yaml
math:
scale: 2
```

For example, with `scale: 2`, multiplying `10` by `0.333333` produces `3.33`.

## List of match calculate format

`max` - Compare two number and return bigger value. (`max(4,5)`)

`min` - Compare two number and return smaller value. (`min(4,5)`)

`()` - Create a parenthetical expression which will be evaluated first (`3 * (4 + 1)`)

`$` - Denotes a variable (`$1 / 3`)

`e` - Euler's constant (`log(e)`)

`pi` - pi (`sin(pi)`)

`+` - Add two numbers (`1 + 1`)

`-` - Subtract two numbers, or negate one (`3-2`, `-(4+2)`)

`/` - Divide two numbers (`3 / 4`)

`*` - Multiply two numbers (`2 * 3`)

`^` - Raise one number to the power of another (`3^3`)

`%` - Take the modulus, or division remainder, of one number with another (`7 % 4`)

`abs` - Take the absolute value of a number (`abs$1`, `abs-1`)

`round` - Rounds a number to the nearest integer (`round1.5`, `round(2.3)`)

`ceil` - Rounds a number up to the nearest integer (`ceil1.05`)

`floor` - Rounds a number down to the nearest integer (`floor0.95`)

`rand` - Generate a random number between 0 and the specified upper bound (`rand4`)

`log` - Get the natural logarithm of a number (`log(e)`)

`sqrt` - Get the square root of a number (`sqrt4`)

`cbrt` - Get the cube root of a number (`cbrt(8)`)

`sin` - Get the sine of a number (`sin$2`)

`cos` - Get the cosine of a number (`cos(2*pi)`)

`tan` - Get the tangent of a number (`tanpi`)

`asin` - Get the arcsine of a number (`asin$2`)

`acos` - Get the arccosine of a number (`acos0.45`)

`atan` - Get the arctangent of a number (`atan1`)

`sinh` - Get the hyperbolic sine of a number (`sinh(4)`)

`cosh` - Get the hyperbolic cosine of a number (`sinh(4)`)

`true` - Boolean constant representing 1

`false` - Boolean constant representing 0

`=` - Compare if two numbers are equal (`1 = 1` will be `1`, `1 = 3` will be `0`), also accepts `==`

`!=` - Compare if two numbers are not equal (`1 != 2` will be `1`, `1 != 1` will be `0`)

`>` - Compare if one number is greater than another (`1 > 0`)

`=` - Compare if one number is greater than or equal to another (`1 >= 1`)

` The upper boundary of a random range is exclusive. For example, `random(1, 5)` can return values greater than or equal to `1`, but it will not return exactly `5`.

### Function Summary

| Function | Description | No-argument result |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | -----------------: |
| `sum(...)` | Adds all provided numbers | `0` |
| `max(...)` | Returns the largest provided number | `0` |
| `min(...)` | Returns the smallest provided number | `0` |
| `avg(...)` | Returns the arithmetic average | `0` |
| `random()` | Returns a random value from `0` to `1` | Random value |
| `random(max)` | Returns a random value between `0` and `max` | Not applicable |
| `random(min, max)` | Returns a random value between two values | Not applicable |

📊Understanding YAML/This wiki

In the UltimateShop plugin, all configuration files use the YAML format. Understanding YAML syntax is essential for editing and customizing your setup. Let’s go through it with real examples from the plugin.

Basic Syntax

The basic structure of YAML is key: value. Example:

Copy

debug: false

Important Rules:

Keys are case-sensitive.

There must be a space after the colon.

When the value contains special characters (: or &), wrap it in quotes: prefix: "&a[UltimateShop]"

When the value contains a single quote ('), escape it with two single quotes: message: "You can''t buy this item!"

Hierarchy & Indentation

Indentation represents parent-child relationships in YAML. Each level must be indented by two spaces. Example:

Copy

auto-save:
hide-message: false

Here:

auto-save is the parent key.

hide-message is its child key, means this option only work for auto save feature.

false is the value, means we will not hide message when auto save.

Let us take shop configs as complex example:

1️⃣ Level 1 (Top Level) There are two main root keys:

settings

items

They exist side by side at the top of the configuration. This is shop configs, so you should get available top level options at Shops page. In that page, we told you available keys with very big font size.

with very detalied example.

All of them has detelied info:

2️⃣ Level 2 Under settings:

menu

buy-more

shop-name

hide-message
are all child keys of settings.

This means all of them are settings for this shop. Put them in other place will NOT work.

Under items:

A is a child key representing a product. A means this product ID is A, and all section under A will only work for this product.

3️⃣ Level 3 Under items → A:

price-mode

product-mode

products

buy-prices

and so on.
are all children of A. All of those options will only work for product A, and should not put them in other place.

Since it is product config, you can get all options available at Products page with detalied info.

4️⃣ Level 4 Under products:

“1” means the first defined product.

Under buy-prices:

“1” means the first defined price set.

You can set unlimited sub price and product. All of those options available at Single Things page.

5️⃣ Level 5 Under products → 1:

material: GRASS_BLOCK → the item type.

amount: 1 → the quantity.

They are following ItemFormat.

Under buy-prices → 1:

economy-plugin: Vault → the economy system used.

amount: '0.63' → the price.

placeholder: '{amount}$' → how the price is displayed.

They are following EconomyFormat and placeholder option inside price section.

Lists

When a key holds multiple values, use a list.

Example:

Each “-” must be indented two spaces from its parent key.

Empty and Default Values

An empty list is represented as:

The [] means the list is empty, and the plugin will use its default settings.
This line can usually be safely removed.

# 📊Understanding YAML/This wiki

In the UltimateShop plugin, all configuration files use the YAML format. Understanding YAML syntax is essential for editing and customizing your setup. Let’s go through it with real examples from the plugin.

***

## Basic Syntax

The basic structure of YAML is `key: value`. Example:

```yaml
debug: false
```

Important Rules:

1. Keys are case-sensitive.
2. There must be a space after the colon.
3. When the value contains special characters (`:` or `&`), wrap it in quotes: `prefix: "&a[UltimateShop]"`
4. When the value contains a single quote (`'`), escape it with two single quotes: `message: "You can''t buy this item!"`

## Hierarchy & Indentation

Indentation represents parent-child relationships in YAML. Each level must be indented by two spaces. Example:

```yaml
auto-save:
hide-message: false
```

Here:

* `auto-save` is the parent key.
* `hide-message` is its child key, means this option only work for auto save feature.
* `false` is the value, means we will not hide message when auto save.

Let us take shop configs as complex example:

```yaml
settings:
menu: 'example-shop-menu'
buy-more: true
shop-name: 'Blocks Shop'
hide-message: false

items:
A:
price-mode: CLASSIC_ALL
product-mode: CLASSIC_ALL
products:
1:
material: GRASS_BLOCK
amount: 1
buy-prices:
1:
economy-plugin: Vault
amount: '0.63'
placeholder: '{amount}$'
```

1️⃣ Level 1 (Top Level) There are two main root keys:

* settings
* items

They exist side by side at the top of the configuration. This is shop configs, so you should get available top level options at [Shops](/shops/shops.md) page. In that page, we told you available keys with very big font size.

with very detalied example.

All of them has detelied info:

2️⃣ Level 2 Under `settings`:

* menu
* buy-more
* shop-name
* hide-message\
are all **child keys** of settings.

This means all of them are settings for this shop. Put them in other place will **NOT** work.

Under items:

* **A** is a **child key** representing a product. `A` means this product ID is `A`, and all section under `A` will only work for this product.

items:
buy-prices: # Will not work
1:
economy-plugin: Vault
amount: '0.63'
placeholder: '{amount}$'
A:
menu: 'example-shop-menu' # Will not work.
buy-more: true # Will not work.
shop-name: 'Blocks Shop' # Will not work.
hide-message: false # Will not work.
price-mode: CLASSIC_ALL # Only work for product A
product-mode: CLASSIC_ALL # Only work for product A
products: # Only work for product A
1:
material: GRASS_BLOCK
amount: 1

3️⃣ Level 3 Under `items` → `A`:

* price-mode
* product-mode
* products
* buy-prices
* and so on.\
are all **children** of `A`. All of those options will only work for product A, and should not put them in other place.

Since it is product config, you can get all options available at [Products](/shops/products.md) page with detalied info.

```yaml
items: # Will work.
B: # Will work.
products: # Will work.
1: # Will work.
material: APPLE # Will work.
amount: 64 # Will work.
give-actions: # Will work.
1: # Will work.
multi-once: true # Will work.
type: message # Will work.
message: 'eco give {player} {amount}' # Will work.
```

4️⃣ Level 4 Under `products`:

* “`1`” means the first defined product.

Under buy-prices:

* “`1`” means the first defined price set.

You can set unlimited sub price and product. All of those options available at [Single Things](/shops/products-config-single-thing.md) page.

5️⃣ Level 5 Under `products` → `1`:

* `material: GRASS_BLOCK` → the item type.
* `amount: 1` → the quantity.

They are following [ItemFormat](/format/itemformat-tm.md).

Under `buy-prices` → `1`:

* `economy-plugin: Vault` → the economy system used.
* `amount: '0.63'` → the price.
* `placeholder: '{amount}$'` → how the price is displayed.

They are following [EconomyFormat](/format/economyformat-tm.md) and placeholder option inside price section.

## Hierarchical Tree Diagram

```fish
settings
│
├─ menu
├─ buy-more
├─ shop-name
└─ hide-message

items
└─ A
├─ price-mode
├─ product-mode
├─ products
│ └─ 1
│ ├─ material
│ └─ amount
└─ buy-prices
└─ 1
├─ economy-plugin
├─ amount
└─ placeholder
```

## Lists

When a key holds multiple values, use a list.

Example:

menu:
secret-shop-items:
- diamond_sword
- netherite_pickaxe
- enchanted_golden_apple

Each “`-`” must be indented two spaces from its parent key.

## Empty and Default Values

An empty list is represented as:

```yaml
menu:
secret-shop-items: []
```

The `[]` means the list is empty, and the plugin will use its default settings.\
This line can usually be safely removed.

📦Info

⌨️Commands & Permissions

FAQ:

Does the /shop command has permission?

A: Use /shop can directly open a menu called main. This is a feature called Auto Open, and you can disable it at config.yml file with menu.auto-open.enabled option. If you only want some players to be exposed to this command, you can set conditions for the menu so that only players who meet the specified conditions can open the menu. For more info, please view Menus page.

Why it say condition not meet when open daily example menu?

A: That menu already has a condition, which you can find in menus/shop_menu_templates/daily-shop-menu.yml.

ultimateshop.bypassprice

This permission can help you bypass price check and won't cost any price.

ultimateshop.bypass.protection

This permission can help you bypass protection (anti grief) check when using sell stick.

/shop menu <menuID>/<shopID>

Open common menu or shop menu.

Require ultimateshop.menu permission.

For console, should extra add <player> arg at the end of command, like /shop menu test Player1.

Support add -b at the end of the command to bypass menu open condition check. (Premium version only)

/shop quickbuy <shopID> <productID> [amount]

Quick purchase item.

Require ultimateshop.quickbuy permission.

For console, should extra add <player> arg at the end of command, like /shop quickbuy test A Player1.

/shop quicksell <shopID> <productID> [amount]

Same as quickbuy, just replace quickbuy to quicksell.

amount arg can be replaced to * symbol, then plugin will auto sell all the items you can sell. (Premium version only)

If the corresponding product is not displayed in the shop GUI, or if the player does not meet the conditions to open the corresponding shop menu, the item cannot be traded. If this is not desired, change the settings.secret-shop-items option in the shop configuration to false.

/shop reload

Reload the plugin, some configs need you restart server.

Require ultimateshop.reload permission.

/shop givesellstick <itemID> <playerID> [amount] (Premium version only)

Give specifeid player specified amount (if not set, default to 1) sell stick.

Require ultimateshop.givesellstick permission.

/shop givesellchest <itemID> <playerID> [amount] (Premium version only)

Give specifeid player specified amount (if not set, default to 1) sell chest.

Require ultimateshop.givesellstick permission.

/shop setbuytimes/setselltimes <shopID> <productID> <player>/global [times]

Set player's specified product buy times to specified value.

Require ultimateshop.setbuytimes permission.

If didn't set times arg, we will think you are trying to reset the buy/sell times.

productID arg can be replaced to * symbol, then plugin will auto pick up all product in specified shop. (Premium version only)

setselltimes is similar to setbuytimes here.

The global arg means set buy/sell times for {buy-times-server} or {sell-times-server} placeholer, not means set buy/sell times for all players.

It is impossible to set all player data at once through commands in UltimateShop. Because assuming your server has hundreds of thousands of player data, without excellent performance optimization code, the server will immediately crash. You may see very few economy plugins or item plugins providing this feature, but they are selling it as a selling point. We have not declared ourselves providing this feature on any occasion, and this feature will not be added in the future because it is very time-consuming and not very meaningful. You can achieve similar functions through the auto reset function, and relevant information can be viewed on this page.

/shop addbuytimes/addselltimes <shopID> <productID> <player>/global <times>

Add specified value to player's specified product buy times.

Require ultimateshop.addtbuytimes permission.

productID arg can be replaced to * symbol, then plugin will auto pick up all product in specified shop. (Premium version only)

addselltimes is similar to setbuytimes here.

/shop sellall

Open sellall menu.

Require ultimateshop.sellall permission.

/shop saveitem <saveItemID> <saveItemMethod>

Save your hold items. For more info, please view Save Item page.

Require ultimateshop.saveitem permission.

/shop givesaveitem [player] [amount]

Give a saved item from plugins/UltimateShop/items/. The ID is the file name without .yml. In game, /shop givesaveitem component-test gives the item to yourself; /shop givesaveitem component-test PlayerName 1 targets an online player. The console must specify a player.

Require ultimateshop.givesaveitem permission. See Saved Item for creating and reloading ItemFormat files.

/shop generateitemformat

Generate the item held in your main hand into plugins/UltimateShop/generated-item-format.yml. Each use overwrites this file. debuild-item-method: COMPONENT saves supported properties inside component on Paper 1.21.5+ with UltimateShop Premium. See Testing Paper Components for a save/rebuild walkthrough.

Require ultimateshop.generateitemformat permission.

/shop getplaceholdervalue <text> (Premium version only)

Parse input text to get placeholder value in it.

Require ultimateshop.getplaceholdervalue permission.

/shop resetrandomplaceholder <placeholderID> [player] (Premium version only)

Reset random placeholder value.

The per player's random placeholder must enter the player name in the command parameters, while the none-per player's random placeholder cannot enter the player name in the command parameters, otherwise the plugin will prompt an error.

Require ultimateshop.resetrandomplaceholder permission.

/shop setrandomplaceholder <placeholderID> [element] [player] (Premium version only)

Set random placeholder value.

Different from resetrandomplaceholder, setrandomplaceholder command won't reset refresh time and allow users pick specifeid element.

The per player's random placeholder must enter the player name in the command parameters, while the per player's random placeholder cannot enter the player name in the command parameters, otherwise the plugin will prompt an error.

Support add -b at the end of the command to bypass element exist check, which means you can set the custom element you'd like. For example, my random placeholder only have A,B,C total 3 elements, if I type D as element here, plugin will print error message, if you add -b suffix, then the placeholder value will be set to D and plugin never print error message, but it is not recommended. (Removed in 3.12.0, now this command no longer check element exist)

Require ultimateshop.setrandomplaceholder permission.

/shop search

Print the message that helps you know the hold item target product in shop.

Require ultimateshop.search permission.

/shop sellhand

Sell the entire stack in your main hand only.

Require ultimateshop.sellhand permission.

/shop sellallhand

Sell all hand item.

Require ultimateshop.sellallhand permission.

sellhand = sell only the held stack.
sellallhand = use the held item as selector, then sell matching items from inventory.

/shop updategui [player]

Update GUI for specified player. Only buttons will be updated, inventory title will not update.

Require ultimateshop.updategui permission.

/shop updateguititle [player] (Premium version only)

Update GUI title for specifed player. Only gui title will be updated, buttons will not update.

Require server enable title update feature, for more info, please view this page.

Require ultimateshop.updateguititle permission.

/shop editor (Premium version only)

Open the built-in in-game editor. Set editor.enabled: true in config.yml and reload the plugin to enable it. Back up the plugin configuration before every use. No separate editor addon is needed.

Use /shop editor <scope> <id> to open a file directly. Scopes are shop, menu, shop_menu_template, buy_more_menu, favourite_menu, search_menu and item_sell_menu. IDs omit .yml; specialized menu scopes use their matching folders under menus/. See In-game Editor for UI presets and saving changes.

Require ultimateshop.editor permission.

Custom Placeholder Commands (Premium version only)

For command list of custom placeholder feature, please view this page.

# ⌨️Commands & Permissions

## FAQ:

### Does the /shop command has permission?

A: Use `/shop` can directly open a menu called `main`. This is a feature called **Auto Open**, and you can disable it at `config.yml` file with `menu.auto-open.enabled` option. If you only want some players to be exposed to this command, you can set `conditions` for the menu so that only players who meet the specified conditions can open the menu. For more info, please view [Menus](/menu-types/general-menus.md) page.

### Why it say condition not meet when open daily example menu?

A: That menu already has a condition, which you can find in `menus/shop_menu_templates/daily-shop-menu.yml`.

## ultimateshop.bypassprice

This permission can help you bypass price check and won't cost any price.

## ultimateshop.bypass.protection

This permission can help you bypass protection (anti grief) check when using sell stick.

## /shop menu \/\

Open common menu or shop menu.

Require `ultimateshop.menu` permission.

For console, should extra add `
` arg at the end of command, like `/shop menu test Player1`.

Support add `-b` at the end of the command to bypass menu open condition check. **(Premium version only)**

## /shop quickbuy \ \
\[amount]

Quick purchase item.

Require `ultimateshop.quickbuy` permission.

For console, should extra add `
` arg at the end of command, like `/shop quickbuy test A Player1`.

## /shop quicksell \ \
\[amount]

Same as `quickbuy`, just replace `quickbuy` to `quicksell`.

`amount` arg can be replaced to `*` symbol, then plugin will auto sell all the items you can sell. **(Premium version only)**

{% hint style="warning" %}
If the corresponding product is not displayed in the shop GUI, or if the player does not meet the conditions to open the corresponding shop menu, the item cannot be traded. If this is not desired, change the `settings.secret-shop-items` option in the shop configuration to `false`.
{% endhint %}

## /shop reload

Reload the plugin, some configs need you restart server.

Require `ultimateshop.reload` permission.

## /shop givesellstick \ \
\[amount] **(Premium version only)**

Give specifeid player specified amount (if not set, default to **1**) [sell stick](/features/sell-stick-premium.md).

Require `ultimateshop.givesellstick` permission.

## /shop givesellchest \ \
\[amount] **(Premium version only)**

Give specifeid player specified amount (if not set, default to **1**) [sell chest](/features/sell-chest-premium.md).

Require `ultimateshop.givesellstick` permission.

## /shop setbuytimes/setselltimes \ \
\
/global \[times]

Set player's specified product buy times to specified value.

Require `ultimateshop.setbuytimes` permission.

If didn't set `times` arg, we will think you are trying to reset the buy/sell times.

`productID` arg can be replaced to `*` symbol, then plugin will auto pick up all product in specified shop. **(Premium version only)**

`setselltimes` is similar to setbuytimes here.

{% hint style="info" %}
The global arg means set buy/sell times for `{buy-times-server}` or `{sell-times-server}` placeholer, not means set buy/sell times for all players.

It is **impossible** to set all player data at once through commands in UltimateShop. Because assuming your server has hundreds of thousands of player data, without excellent performance optimization code, the server will immediately crash. You may see very few economy plugins or item plugins providing this feature, but they are selling it as a selling point. We have not declared ourselves providing this feature on any occasion, and this feature will not be added in the future because it is very time-consuming and not very meaningful. You can achieve similar functions through the **auto reset** function, and relevant information can be viewed on [this page](/shops/product-config-buy-sell-times-reset.md).
{% endhint %}

## /shop addbuytimes/addselltimes \ \
\
/global \

Add specified value to player's specified product buy times.

Require `ultimateshop.addtbuytimes` permission.

`productID` arg can be replaced to `*` symbol, then plugin will auto pick up all product in specified shop. **(Premium version only)**

`addselltimes` is similar to setbuytimes here.

## /shop sellall

Open sellall menu.

Require `ultimateshop.sellall` permission.

## /shop saveitem \ \

Save your hold items. For more info, please view [Save Item](/features/saved-item-item-manager.md) page.

Require `ultimateshop.saveitem` permission.

## /shop givesaveitem \[player] \[amount]

Give a saved item from `plugins/UltimateShop/items/`. The ID is the file name without `.yml`. In game, `/shop givesaveitem component-test` gives the item to yourself; `/shop givesaveitem component-test PlayerName 1` targets an online player. The console must specify a player.

Require `ultimateshop.givesaveitem` permission. See [Saved Item](/features/saved-item-item-manager.md) for creating and reloading ItemFormat files.

## /shop generateitemformat

Generate the item held in your main hand into `plugins/UltimateShop/generated-item-format.yml`. Each use overwrites this file. `debuild-item-method: COMPONENT` saves supported properties inside `component` on Paper 1.21.5+ with UltimateShop Premium. See [Testing Paper Components](https://github.com/ManyouTeam/UltimateShop/tree/master/docs/format/itemformat-tm/component-testing.md) for a save/rebuild walkthrough.

Require `ultimateshop.generateitemformat` permission.

## /shop getplaceholdervalue \ **(Premium version only)**

Parse input text to get placeholder value in it.

Require `ultimateshop.getplaceholdervalue` permission.

## /shop resetrandomplaceholder \
\[player] **(Premium version only)**

Reset random placeholder value.

The per player's random placeholder must enter the player name in the command parameters, while the none-per player's random placeholder cannot enter the player name in the command parameters, otherwise the plugin will prompt an error.

Require `ultimateshop.resetrandomplaceholder` permission.

## /shop setrandomplaceholder \
\[element] \[player] **(Premium version only)**

Set random placeholder value.

Different from `resetrandomplaceholder`, `setrandomplaceholder` command won't reset refresh time and allow users pick specifeid element.

The per player's random placeholder must enter the player name in the command parameters, while the per player's random placeholder cannot enter the player name in the command parameters, otherwise the plugin will prompt an error.

~~Support add `-b` at the end of the command to bypass element exist check, which means you can set the custom element you'd like. For example, my random placeholder only have `A,B,C` total 3 elements, if I type **D** as element here, plugin will print error message, if you add `-b` suffix, then the placeholder value will be set to **D** and plugin never print error message, but it is not recommended.~~ (Removed in 3.12.0, now this command no longer check element exist)

Require `ultimateshop.setrandomplaceholder` permission.

## /shop search

Print the message that helps you know the hold item target product in shop.

Require `ultimateshop.search` permission.

## /shop sellhand

Sell the entire stack in your main hand only.

Require `ultimateshop.sellhand` permission.

## /shop sellallhand

Sell all hand item.

Require `ultimateshop.sellallhand` permission.

{% hint style="info" %}
sellhand = sell only the held stack.\
sellallhand = use the held item as selector, then sell matching items from inventory.
{% endhint %}

## /shop updategui \[player]

Update GUI for specified player. Only buttons will be updated, inventory title will not update.

Require `ultimateshop.updategui` permission.

## /shop updateguititle \[player] **(Premium version only)**

Update GUI title for specifed player. Only gui title will be updated, buttons will not update.

Require server enable title update feature, for more info, please view [this page](/menu-types/general-menus.md#title-update-premium).

Require `ultimateshop.updateguititle` permission.

## /shop editor **(Premium version only)**

Open the built-in in-game editor. Set `editor.enabled: true` in `config.yml` and reload the plugin to enable it. Back up the plugin configuration before every use. No separate editor addon is needed.

Use `/shop editor ` to open a file directly. Scopes are `shop`, `menu`, `shop_menu_template`, `buy_more_menu`, `favourite_menu`, `search_menu` and `item_sell_menu`. IDs omit `.yml`; specialized menu scopes use their matching folders under `menus/`. See [In-game Editor](/features/in-game-editor-premium.md) for UI presets and saving changes.

Require `ultimateshop.editor` permission.

## Custom Placeholder Commands **(Premium version only)**

For command list of custom placeholder feature, please view [this page](/placeholders/custom-placeholder-premium.md).

📦Info

🆚Compare

Free

Premium

More Commands
Some commands are only available for premium version. For more info, please view Commands page.

❌

✅

More Command Args
Premium version supports more command args. Like use * means all products. For more info, please view Commands page.

❌

✅

Bedrock Menus
Premium version automatically translates Java menus into Bedrock Form UI and supports automatic vanilla item icons and manually configured custom icons. For more info, please view Bedrock Menus page.

❌

✅

Dialog Menus
Premium version supports Minecraft's native Dialog UI on Paper 1.21.9 or newer for Java clients. Reuse existing menu files with action buttons or the item-action-list layout, including item icons and clickable labels. These layouts do not require a resource pack. For more info, please view Dialog Menus page.

❌

✅

Ore Resource-Pack Menus
Premium version supports a graphical Dialog layout with custom backgrounds, buttons and product cards. Product cards display an item icon beside the product name and lore, with a details button for buying and selling. Customize textures and layout templates while reusing existing menu conditions and actions. Requires Paper 1.21.9 or newer, Java clients and the generated resource pack. For more info, please view Ore Resource-Pack Layout page.

❌

✅

Multi Server Sync
Premium version supports sync global server's data with multi server in one proxy server. For more info, please view Multi Server Sync page.

❌

✅

Localized Item Name
Premium version supports display item localized name for item without custom name. For more info, please view Localized Item Name page.

❌

✅

Random Placeholder
Premium version supports use built-in random placeholder. For more info, please view Random Placeholders page.

❌

✅

Conditional Placeholder
Premium version supports use built-in conditional placeholder. For more info, please view Coditional Placeholders page.

❌

✅

Custom Placeholder (Beta)
Premium version supports custom numeric or text values, stored separately for each player or shared globally. Use commands to set values or add to numeric values, then display them with custom placeholders. For more info, please view Custom Placeholder page.

❌

✅

Dynamic Price Status
Premium version allows you compare the now price and the base price of dynamic price and display the status at product info lore. For more info, please view Dynamic Price Status page.

❌

✅

Sell Multiplier
Premium version supports conditional sell bonuses or taxes. Choose the highest matching multiplier with MAX, or multiply matching entries together with STACK. For more info, please view Sell Multiplier page.

❌

✅

Price Modifier (Experimental)
Adjust sell rewards according to the actual item being sold, including durability, numeric values from lore or NBT, and MythicChanger matching rules. Enable it per product with price-modifier: true. This feature is experimental; some modifier types require additional plugins. For more info, please view Price Modifier page.

✅

✅

More Built-in Placeholders
Premium version supports more built-in placeholders. For more info, please view Built-in Placeholders page.

❌

✅

More Advanced Actions
Premium version supports use more advanced actions. For more info, please view Action Format page.

❌

✅

More Advanced Conditions
Premium version supports use more advanced conditions. For more info, please view Condition Format page.

❌

✅

More Advanced Reset Mode
Premium version supports use more advanced product buy times or sell times reset mode. For more info, please view Buy/Sell Times Reset page.

❌

✅

Sell Stick
Premium version allows you create and use sell stick to quickly sell all contents from the container. For more info, please view Sell Stick page.

❌

✅

Sell Chest (Experimental)
Premium version supports sell chests that automatically sell their contents while the chunk is loaded and the owner is online. Configure usage limits, sell multipliers and hologram information. Folia is not supported. For more info, please view Sell Chest page.

❌

✅

More ItemFormat™ Key Support
Premium version supports additional ItemFormat™ options, including AdvancedEnchantments integration, Data Components on Paper 1.21.6 or newer, and Equippable settings on Minecraft 1.21.2 or newer. For more info, please view ItemFormat page.

❌

✅

Log Transaction
Premium version allows you use this feature to log all translation info, you can easily check things like whether your price settings are working correctly as you want. For more info, please view Log Transaction page.

❌

✅

Custom Click Event
Premium version allows you to customize what happens when players click on products with different buttons. For more info, please view Custom Click Event page.

❌

✅

Custom Single Thing Type
Premium version allows you use CUSTOM single thing type. For more info, please view Single Thing page.

❌

✅

Sub Button for Products
This feature allows you display same product at multi slot or menus, even support display different item at different slot or menu, but, they are still same product. For more info, please view Products page.

❌

✅

Dynamic Layout
Premium version users can use dynamic values in menu layout. For more info, please view General Menus page.

❌

✅

Conditional Display
Premium version supports displaying different products or buttons in the same menu slot according to conditions. Entries are checked in order, allowing fallback choices when a condition is not met. For more info, please view Conditional Display page.

❌

✅

Custom Command
Premium version users can add custom command to open common menus or shop menus. For more info, please view General Menus page.

❌

✅

Auto Update GUI Title
Premium version supports auto update GUI title after each click or each seconds. For more info, please view General Menus page.

❌

✅

Per Player Language & Advanced Language Message Format (Support send boss bar, action bar, sound, title in message!)
Click here to know more.

❌

✅

Shulker Box Sell (Alpha)
After enable this feature in config.yml file, plugin will auto check content of shulker box and sell them. Should support common sell, sell stick, sell all GUI, sell chest and so on.

❌

✅

In-game Editor
Open the in-game editor with /shop editor to edit shops, products and menus. For more info, please view In-game Editor page.

❌

✅

Search GUI
You can search product you want in Search GUI. For more info, please view this page.

❌

✅

Favourite Menus
Premium version allows players to save favourite products and access them from a dedicated menu. Players can reorder or remove saved products in edit mode. For more info, please view Favourite Menus page.

❌

✅

Shared Product Data (Alpha)
You can set multi product share same product data like buy times/sell times/limits/cooldown reset time and so on. For more info, please view this page.

❌

✅

More...
Many small differences were not mentioned here or, I forgot them put here, and more features that are only available in the paid version will be added in the future!

More Command Args
Premium version supports more command args. Like use * means all products. For more info, please view Commands page.

❌

✅

-

Bedrock Menus
Premium version automatically translates Java menus into Bedrock Form UI and supports automatic vanilla item icons and manually configured custom icons. For more info, please view Bedrock Menus page.

❌

✅

❌

Dialog Menus
Premium version supports Minecraft's native Dialog UI on Paper 1.21.9 or newer for Java clients. Reuse existing menu files with action buttons or the item-action-list layout, including item icons and clickable labels. These layouts do not require a resource pack. For more info, please view Dialog Menus page.

❌

✅

Ore Resource-Pack Menus
Premium version supports a graphical Dialog layout with custom backgrounds, buttons and product cards. Product cards display an item icon beside the product name and lore, with a details button for buying and selling. Customize textures and layout templates while reusing existing menu conditions and actions. Requires Paper 1.21.9 or newer, Java clients and the generated resource pack. For more info, please view Ore Resource-Pack Layout page.

❌

✅

Multi Server Sync
Premium version supports sync global server's data with multi server in one proxy server. For more info, please view Multi Server Sync page.

❌

✅

❓
Some of them are support use MySQL as database (this was available for free version), but we also support use BungeeCord plugin message channel to sync data.

Localized Item Name
Premium version supports display item localized name for item without custom name. For more info, please view Localized Item Name page.

✅

❌

❌

✅

❌

Custom Placeholder (Beta)
Premium version supports custom numeric or text values, stored separately for each player or shared globally. Use commands to set values or add to numeric values, then display them with custom placeholders. For more info, please view Custom Placeholder page.

❌

✅

Dynamic Price Status
Premium version allows you compare the now price and the base price of dynamic price and display the status at product info lore. For more info, please view Dynamic Price Status page.

❌

✅

❓
Some of them maybe support this, but don't forgot our dynamic price support use various mathematical formulas and placeholders.

Sell Multiplier
Premium version supports conditional sell bonuses or taxes. Choose the highest matching multiplier with MAX, or multiply matching entries together with STACK. For more info, please view Sell Multiplier page.

❌

✅

Price Modifier (Experimental)
Adjust sell rewards according to the actual item being sold, including durability, numeric values from lore or NBT, and MythicChanger matching rules. Enable it per product with price-modifier: true. This feature is experimental; some modifier types require additional plugins. For more info, please view Price Modifier page.

✅

Sell Chest (Experimental)
Premium version supports sell chests that automatically sell their contents while the chunk is loaded and the owner is online. Configure usage limits, sell multipliers and hologram information. Folia is not supported. For more info, please view Sell Chest page.

More ItemFormat™ Key Support
Premium version supports additional ItemFormat™ options, including AdvancedEnchantments integration, Data Components on Paper 1.21.6 or newer, and Equippable settings on Minecraft 1.21.2 or newer. For more info, please view ItemFormat page.

❌

✅

❓
Many of them are just support few vanilla component, but ItemFormat™ support almost all of vanilla component!

Log Transaction

📦Info

🔗Compatibility

The compatibility of plugins mainly includes hooks for item plugins and economy plugins. Unlike other plugins of the same type, we can support them regardless of their appearance. There are two methods to support them: direct compatibility and indirect compatibility.

Direct compatibility

Direct compatibility refers to the use of item plugins or the economy of economic plugins directly in ItemFormat or EconomyFormat. This compatibility method is the simplest and officially supported.

Directly supported item plugins list

ItemsAdder

Oraxen

EcoItems

EcoArmor

MMOItems

MythicMobs

eco

NeigeItems

ExecutableItems

Nexo

CraftEngine

You can use ItemBridge as custom item provider which supports more custom item plugins, click here to know more.

Directly supported economy plugins list

PlayerPoints

CoinsEngine

UltraEconomy

EcoBits

PEconomy

RedisEconomy

RoyaleEconomy

VotingPlugin

The following provides an example of directly obtaining items from the ItemsAdder plugin through the direct compatibility feature in ItemFormat and using economy from Vault plugin in EconomyFormat:

Directly supported protection plugins list

Although the protection plugin you are using is not on this list, as long as the corresponding plugin can prevent the player from interacting with the corresponding container, UltimateShop will not trigger a sell stick, depending on how the author of the plugin you are using wrote their plugin.

If players do not have permission to open container within these protection plugins areas, UltimateShop can prevent players use sell stick in these areas.

BentoBox

Dominion

GriefPrevention

HuskTowns

HuskClaims

Lands

PlotSquared

Residence

Towny

WorldGuard

SuperiorSkyblock2

Directly supported hologram plugins list

Support create hologram to display sell chest info.

CMI

DecentHolograms

FancyHolograms

Indirect compatibility

Indirect compatibility refers to the flexible use of various features of plugins to enable them to associate with these plugins.

Save Item: We told you a command called /shop saveitem at Commands page, we also told you can set material option in Item Format to the save item ID you was set to use them.

Buy Actions: We told you a option called buy-actions in shop configs at Shops page. In Actions page, we also told you we support use command in actions, so just use the give item command here, all is done.

Give Actions: We told you this feature at Single Things page which is very similar to Buy Actions. What's more, we even give you an example at that page.

Example: Use for not supported item plugins as products

In this example, we first fill in the ItemFormat through the display item option to describe the item from an incompatible plugin, so that players can see what the item looks like in the menu.

In the products option, we use the Custom Sell Match feature, which allows us to flexibly set the rules for selling matches for this item, such as contains-lore, etc. Then, we use give-actions format to execute the item give command, so that player can obtain this item after buy.

If you use the Paper server and the item is fixed (the items generated each time are identical), you can use the Save item function: you only need to use the /shop saveitem command, then use the material option in ItemFormat, and fill in the ID of the save item in this option.

Example: Use for not supported economy plugins as prices.

In this example, we mainly flexibly implemented different types of single thing and give-actions and take-actions options, whose functions can be found on the Products page. Specifically, assuming the player purchases this product, the match-placeholder in buy options is used to determine if the player has enough economy. If it meets the buy-prices requirement, the player will receive an apple in products section and execute take-actions section in buy-prices section. Similarly, during selling, as the player obtains the sell price, the give-actions in the sell price will be executed, and therefore the player will receive economy.

Require PREMIUM version of UltimateShop!

MythicChanger: Extra Item Format option

Through this hook, based on the ItemFormat, items can be further modified to their desired appearance.

This feature require your server must install MythicChanger plugin, please get it here:

FREE: Click to download

PREMIUM: Click to download

For how to configure the change-item section, please read MythicChanger's wiki, click here to visit. Please note that some of the change rules require PREMIUM version of MythicChanger, not PREMIUM version of UltimateShop!

AdvancedEnchantments: Extra Item Format option - Premium

Through this hook, based on the ItemFormat, items can have custom enchantments from AdvancedmentEnchantments.

Plugin like EcoEnchants, ExcellentEnchants are vanilla enchants like plugin, you just need to put their enchantment ID to enchants option in ItemFormat.

You can use plugin-enchants option to add plugin enchants for your item.

NBTAPI: Extra Item Format option - Premium

The format of this option is:

Supported NBT Type: '

byte

short

int

long

float

double

string

For example:

MythicChanger: Custom Item Match

Custom Item Match Method feature requires MythicChanger.

PlaceholderAPI: Extra placeholders

UltimateShop provides those new placeholders to PlaceholderAPI, for more info, please view this page.
